note: `smolcorp gm brief <hire> --text/--file` adds the text, dated, to the end of the working hire's BRIEF file (a managed hire's is in <support>/hires/<id>/), then mails the hire to read it. The text is never typed into its window.
mail-the-hire-gets: Your brief has a new part: read BRIEF.md

refusals.why: the hire is fired or failed, is the GM, or has no BRIEF file
